changes: Qualifying peer continuation can yield an active goal at a response boundary, with exact generation and eligibility rechecks.
Saved assistant GIF and MP4 outputs render inline with paused startup, original download and ephemeral browser playback evidence.

architecture.goals: Native negotiates peerContinuation and yields only a still-active bounded goal at the current root generation. Coordination selects qualified pending peer continuations beyond ordinary queue pages.
architecture.media: Resources owns immutable bytes and exact message/version/hash linkage. Native verifies canonical saved assistant identity or a read-only Main legacy reference; Host reuses short-lived read-only transports but rechecks every proof. UI reports use a selected-client, read-classified ephemeral capability and never enter conversation history or durable command receipts.
architecture.migration: Frozen Main output imports preserve media bytes, version, lineage and original message reference, and reject inconsistent structural metadata.
architecture.performance: Two bounded read-only transports replace per-chunk process startup; local median exact-proof latency decreased from about 281 ms to about 2 ms. This is a local mechanism comparison, not a product-wide performance claim.

composedBrowser: Native muted MP4 playback with presented-frame report
Greater than 8 MiB video and exact original download
Source relocation followed by successful paused reload
No additional model prompt from media rendering or reports

limits: Source and local browser qualification only. Final immutable archive, migration and DTU evidence recorded separately.
